title: Material flow analysis prototype

client.descriptor: an environmental and territorial consulting firm

summary: Python prototype that computes material flows for a territory in a traceable and reproducible way, with AI assistants that cite their sources.
highlights: Scoped a Python prototype that reads an existing Excel data catalogue in read-only mode and computes material flows for a territory.
Planned Sankey diagrams and sourced exports, with snapshots so that any result can be recomputed identically.
Specified AI assistants that cite their sources and have no influence on the calculations, which stay deterministic.
Planned an evaluation against a manual reference analysis: fidelity flow by flow, coverage, reproducibility and time to completion.
